title: Session 1 — Participant 50 User + Claude Behavior Graph
goal: Build an end-to-end AI-assisted customer call workflow in HubSpot that starts with creating a customer company record, prepares a client call prompt, converts the call information into structured tasks/deal/next steps/notes, updates HubSpot, and produces a client follow-up email.
context: I chose this goal because, in Sales and Marketing Ops, there are many steps involved after a client interaction. I want to explore how AI can help make these steps more organized, consistent, and less time-consuming. For me, the goal is not to replace human judgment with AI, but to use AI as a support tool. I also want the process to make knowledge easier to capture and share, so that someone else can easily understand what happened, what the customer needs, and what should happen next. This can make the sales process more efficient, transparent, and easier to follow.

session_goal_achievement.Why or why not: Claude made my workflow easy as I spent little time than working from scratch for everystep.

Step 1.step_name: Create a Customer Company in HubSpot CRM
Step 1.step_action: Research the customer/company information and identify the relevant company name, website/domain, industry, and other useful CRM information. Use this information to create or update the customer company record in HubSpot, making sure the company domain is associated with the correct organization and that the CRM record contains enough information to support the upcoming client call.

nodes.label: Introduce the workflow and tour HubSpot
nodes.detail: Explains the end-to-end goal and walks through HubSpot's Contacts, Companies, Deals, and Tasks navigation before starting.

nodes.label: Create the EJ company recordin Hubspot
nodes.detail: Adds a new company named 'EJ' (domain ej.com), setting industry to Information Technology and Services and type to Prospect.

nodes.label: Note where Claude research would normally happen
nodes.detail: Points out that Claude would typically be used here to research the company's domain and contacts, but skips it since EJ is an imaginary demo company.

Step 2.step_action: Use Claude/ChatGPT to create a structured client-call prompt based on the customer information collected in Step 1. The prompt should help guide the conversation, identify the customer's needs and pain points, clarify goals and requirements, and capture information that can later be converted into CRM tasks, deals, notes, and follow-up actions.

nodes.label: Introduce self and describe call-prompt requirements
nodes.detail: Opens a new Claude chat, introduces herself as Evelyne (Sales & Marketing Ops), and specifies the prompt needs: overview, participants, key points, action items, and tasks.

nodes.label: Generate the Customer Call Summary Prompt
nodes.detail: Produces a 'Customer Call Summary Prompt' document with five structured sections (Call Overview, Participants, Key Points, Action Items, Tasks/Responsibilities) plus a transcript placeholder.

nodes.label: Review the draft of the generated prompt
Ask Claude to change the Key Points section from prose to bullet points.

Step 3.step_name: Use the Prompt for the Client Call
Step 3.step_action: Use the client call prompt created in Step 2 to structure the customer conversation and capture the important information discussed. After the call, organize the conversation into actionable CRM information by identifying customer requirements, commitments, potential opportunities, follow-up tasks, deadlines, and important notes.

nodes.label: Apply the finished prompt to a call transcript
nodes.detail: Pastes the completed call prompt into a new Claude chat and attaches a call transcript.

nodes.label: Generate the structured call summary
nodes.detail: Returns a structured summary covering Call Overview, Participants, Key Points, Action Items, and Tasks/Responsibilities based on the transcript.

nodes.label: Request a downloadable PDF
nodes.detail: Asks Claude to turn the call summary into a downloadable PDF document.

nodes.label: Generate the downloadable PDF
nodes.detail: Produces a downloadable PDF version of the call recap.

nodes.label: Download the call-recap PDF and catch the naming mismatch
nodes.detail: Downloads the PDF from Claude and notices the output is named 'Meridian' instead of 'EJ' and renames the chat to 'EJ call Recap'.

nodes.label: Upload the call-recap PDF to HubSpot
nodes.detail: Switches to the HubSpot EJ company record and uploads the downloaded call-recap PDF as an attachment.

nodes.label: Ask Claude to identify HubSpot note and task content
nodes.detail: Asks Claude to identify what should be entered into HubSpot as a note and as tasks.

nodes.label: Find HubSpot connector available and ask user whether to use it
Refuse to connect and ask Claude to give the output in text in the chat
Provide formatted HubSpot note and task content
nodes.detail: Returns six structured 'HUBSPOT TASKS' (titles, descriptions, assignees, due dates, priority) and a 'HUBSPOT NOTE' (date, associated contact/company, note type, summary).

nodes.label: Review the note and task content

Step 4.step_name: Fill the Output from Step 3 in HubSpot
Step 4.step_action: Transfer the structured information from Step 3 into the appropriate HubSpot CRM records. Create the identified tasks, update or create the relevant deal/opportunity, record the customer call notes, and add the agreed next steps so that the CRM accurately represents the current customer relationship.

nodes.label: Create the call note and tasks in HubSpot
nodes.detail: Create new note and tasks, pastes Claude's note summary and task content into the EJ company record, and set activity date and reminders.

nodes.label: Ask Claude to identify the deal
nodes.detail: Asks Claude to identify a deal from the transcript, including deal name, amount, and summary, using the attached transcript.

nodes.label: Return the Deal Record
nodes.detail: Provides a Deal Record: Deal Name 'Meridian Logistics Group — ITSM Platform (3-Year Agreement)', Deal Amount, and a one-sentence Deal Summary.

nodes.label: Create the Deal in HubSpot
nodes.detail: Adds a new deal, pastes the deal record into the deal form, and associates it with the EJ company.

nodes.label: Confirm records on the company overview
nodes.detail: Navigates back to the EJ company overview and confirms the new deal appears alongside the previously uploaded call-recap attachment.

Step 5.step_action: Use the completed HubSpot information and the structured call results to prepare a professional follow-up email for the customer. The email should summarize the key points discussed, confirm the agreed next steps, identify responsibilities and timelines where appropriate, and provide a clear path for continuing the conversation.

nodes.label: Ask Claude to draft the follow-up email
nodes.detail: Requests a follow-up email referencing the deal and call summary, including a thank-you, recap, and next steps.

nodes.label: Generate two follow-up email drafts for the user to choose from
nodes.detail: Produces a draft of standard recap and a shorter version with subject , a thank-you opening, bulleted recap, and closing call to action.

nodes.label: Review and paste the standard draft into Gmail
nodes.detail: Copies the standard draft into a new Gmail message and applies 'Remove formatting' to strip Claude's default AI text spacing/font artifacts.

Step 1.step_name: Create a Customer Company in HubSpot CRM
Step 1.step_action: Research the customer/company information and identify the relevant company name, website/domain, industry, and other useful CRM information. Use this information to create or update the customer company record in HubSpot, making sure the company domain is associated with the correct organization and that the CRM record contains enough information to support the upcoming client call.
Step 1.output: Customer Data in HubSpot: A completed HubSpot company record containing the customer's company name, domain/website, industry or relevant company information, and other available CRM details.
Step 1.tools: HubSpot CRM — subscription level to be recorded based on the account used, Claude Max — used to assist with research/organization if applicable
rubrics: The correct customer/company is identified
The company domain/website is accurate and associated with the correct company
The HubSpot company record contains the key available customer information
The information is organized in a way that is useful for future sales/customer interactions
No unsupported or fabricated customer information is added to the CRM

ratings.output_quality_reason: Results I needed were achieve using Claude

goal_achievement.Why or why not: Got the results I needed for the task.

Step 2.step_action: Use Claude/ChatGPT to create a structured client-call prompt based on the customer information collected in Step 1. The prompt should help guide the conversation, identify the customer's needs and pain points, clarify goals and requirements, and capture information that can later be converted into CRM tasks, deals, notes, and follow-up actions.
Step 2.output: Client Call Prompt: A structured AI-generated call prompt containing: Call objective, Suggested opening, Discovery questions, Customer pain-point questions, Business/goals questions, Questions about requirements and timeline, Questions about budget or purchasing process where appropriate, Next-step/commitment questions and Information that should be captured for HubSpot
rubrics: The prompt has a clear objective for the client call
The prompt contains relevant and practical discovery questions
Questions are tailored to the customer's company/context rather than being completely generic
The prompt captures information needed for later HubSpot tasks, deals, notes, and follow-up
The prompt is logically organized and practical to use during a real client conversation

ratings.output_quality_reason: Got the desired Call prompt with few corrections.

goal_achievement.Why or why not: Achieved the Call Prompt as needed

Step 3.step_name: Use the Prompt for the Client Call
Step 3.step_action: Use the client call prompt created in Step 2 to structure the customer conversation and capture the important information discussed. After the call, organize the conversation into actionable CRM information by identifying customer requirements, commitments, potential opportunities, follow-up tasks, deadlines, and important notes.
Step 3.output: Tasks, Potential Deal/Opportunity, Next Steps, Customer/Call Note, Important customer requirements, Follow-up deadlines and Responsibilities/owners
rubrics: Important customer requirements and pain points are correctly identified
Actionable tasks are clearly separated from general discussion points
Each task has a clear action and, when available, an owner and/or deadline
Potential deal/opportunity information is identified only when supported by the conversation
The final notes and next steps accurately reflect the client conversation without inventing information

ratings.output_quality_reason: The call prompt tasks output ere clear and well organized.

Step 4.step_name: Fill the Output from Step 3 in HubSpot
Step 4.step_action: Transfer the structured information from Step 3 into the appropriate HubSpot CRM records. Create the identified tasks, update or create the relevant deal/opportunity, record the customer call notes, and add the agreed next steps so that the CRM accurately represents the current customer relationship.
Step 4.output: Updated HubSpot CRM (Customer company record updated, Call note recorded, Follow-up tasks created, Deal/opportunity created or updated when appropriate, Next steps recorded and Due dates and task owners added where applicable
rubrics: All important tasks identified in Step 3 are represented in HubSpot
Tasks have accurate descriptions and deadlines/owners when those were established
Deal/opportunity information is entered into the appropriate HubSpot record when justified
The call note accurately summarizes the important customer information
HubSpot contains a clear and actionable record of what should happen next

ratings.output_quality_reason: Great job with the HubSpot tasks

Step 5.step_action: Use the completed HubSpot information and the structured call results to prepare a professional follow-up email for the customer. The email should summarize the key points discussed, confirm the agreed next steps, identify responsibilities and timelines where appropriate, and provide a clear path for continuing the conversation.
Step 5.output: Email Draft - A professional client follow-up email containing: Thank-you, Summary of key discussion points, Customer needs or priorities, Agreed next steps, Responsibilities, Relevant deadlines, Clear call to action & Professional closing
rubrics: The email accurately reflects the client call and does not introduce unsupported information
The agreed next steps are clearly communicated
Responsibilities and deadlines are included when they were established
The email is professional, concise, and customer-friendly
The email contains a clear call to action that makes the next step easy for the customer

ratings.output_quality_reason: Emails drafts using Claude require more edits.
